content: IT Monday timetable: 09:00-10:00 Data Structures, 10:00-11:00 DBMS, 11:15-12:15 Computer Networks, 01:00-02:00 Software Engineering, 02:00-04:00 DBMS Lab.
IT Tuesday timetable: 09:00-10:00 Operating Systems, 10:00-11:00 Theory of Computation, 11:15-12:15 Aptitude, 01:00-02:00 AI Basics, 02:00-04:00 Web Technology Lab.
CS Monday timetable: 09:00-10:00 Algorithms, 10:00-11:00 Discrete Mathematics, 11:15-12:15 Compiler Design, 01:00-02:00 Machine Learning, 02:00-04:00 Algorithms Lab.
CS Tuesday timetable: 09:00-10:00 Computer Architecture, 10:00-11:00 Database Systems, 11:15-12:15 Probability and Statistics, 01:00-02:00 Cloud Computing, 02:00-04:00 ML Lab.
ENTC Monday timetable: 09:00-10:00 Signals and Systems, 10:00-11:00 Analog Communication, 11:15-12:15 Network Theory, 01:00-02:00 Digital Electronics, 02:00-04:00 Communication Lab.
ENTC Tuesday timetable: 09:00-10:00 Microcontrollers, 10:00-11:00 Control Systems, 11:15-12:15 Electromagnetics, 01:00-02:00 Embedded Systems, 02:00-04:00 Embedded Lab.
Short breaks are 11:00-11:15 and lunch break is 12:15-01:00 for IT, CS, and ENTC. Labs are generally scheduled in 2-hour blocks in the afternoon.
IT theory classes are usually in Room IT-301 and IT-302. IT labs are in Lab IT-L1 and IT-L2.
CS theory classes are in Room CS-201 and CS-202, CS labs in CS-L1. ENTC theory classes are in ENTC-101 and ENTC-102, ENTC labs in ENTC-L1.
